description: four separate big leafy trees, each with its whole trunk, roots and a big round crown: a wide round oak, a tall dark green pine, a white-bark birch with light green leaves, a weeping willow for a top-down 3/4 view fantasy action RPG, seen from above at an angle, soft shading lit from the upper left, a thin dark outline, rich natural colours, detailed modern pixel art; arranged in a 2 by 2 grid with wide empty space between them, every object whole, not touching the others or the picture edges; on a plain flat pure white background
